Maria: FYI we have an external assessment booked May 6-8. Need an RBAC freeze, KMS grant pattern, and an auditable log export process. Can we list owners and deliverables?
Jonas: Please post scope + assessor contact.
Maria: Scope: staging + canary services (no live writes). Read-only prod logs for triage. Assessor: RedTeamCo, alice@redteam.co. I'll DM readroom creds.
Priya: RBAC proposal: ephemeral assessor roles via short-lived SAML assertions with a scoped policy 'pentest.AssessorReadOnly' 14 no write/admin. Approve?
Ethan: Good. KMS: avoid key material export. Use KMS proxy with time-limited grants that log decrypt operations. @Samir ops window please.
Samir: I can open a 4hr readroom on May 7 14:00-18:00 UTC. Ops will rotate temp keys and enable CloudTrail snapshots for the window. I'll create the ticket and assign tasks.
Maria: Evidence export steps (high level): run export script -> verify SHA256 checksums -> upload to redwood-pt-evidence-2026 bucket -> restrict ACL to assessor role + security-ops -> add manifest with checksums.
Jonas: IAM example (trimmed): ```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["logs:GetLogEvents","logs:DescribeLogGroups","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"*"}]}
```
Priya: Audit snapshot question: how far back? For triage want last 90d + sampled request traces; for legal evidence maybe 365d.
Ethan: Staging retention is 180d, prod 365d. For evidence export snapshot 365d and mark objects as immutable. Ops confirm lifecycle rules.
Samir: Confirmed. I'll create bucket redwood-pt-evidence-2026 with Object Lock (governance), CMEK 'pt-evidence-key', and lifecycle 365d. Will log everything.
Maria: KMS grant model: create a Decrypt-only grant during the window, require assume-role for decrypt calls, log in CloudTrail, revoke after retest. Can do?
Priya: Yes. Use time-limited KMS Grant + require role session tag. Add post-retest revoke task.
Jonas: I created INC-9001 and attached the checklist + preflight steps. Assign remediation-tracker to security-ops.
Samir: Fallback: if readroom provisioning fails, provide redacted logs + sanitized traces (no PII) for initial triage. Documented under 'rollback corridor' in the ticket.
Maria: Retest plan: target 2 weeks after initial run (May 21). Pre-retest dry run May 14 to validate roles, KMS grants, and evidence export. Volunteers: @Jonas, @Priya, @Samir, @Ethan
Priya: I'll own the dry-run smoke script and basic assertions.
sec-bot: Reminder 14 PenTest intake form submitted by Maria. https://redwood.internal/pentest/12345
Maria: Thanks all. Please react to INC-9001. I'll run a 30m sync tomorrow to finalize timeline. :calendar:
